import random, math
from collections import Counter
random.seed(88081757)

def mi(x,y):
 n=len(x); cx=Counter(x); cy=Counter(y); cxy=Counter(zip(x,y)); s=0.0
 for (a,b),c in cxy.items():
  p=c/n; s+=p*math.log(p/((cx[a]/n)*(cy[b]/n)),2)
 return s

def cmi(x,y,z):
 n=len(x); cz=Counter(z); cxz=Counter(zip(x,z)); cyz=Counter(zip(y,z)); cxyz=Counter(zip(x,y,z)); s=0.0
 for (a,b,c),v in cxyz.items():
  p=v/n; pz=cz[c]/n; pxz=cxz[(a,c)]/n; pyz=cyz[(b,c)]/n
  s+=p*math.log((p*pz)/(pxz*pyz),2)
 return s
# role recurrence
N=30000; bag_false=0; role_false=0; true_same=0; role_hit=0
for _ in range(N):
 members=random.sample(range(100000),4); a=tuple(members)
 if random.random()<0.5: b=a; true_same+=1
 else:
  b=a
  while b==a:
   q=members[:]; random.shuffle(q); b=tuple(q)
 if set(a)==set(b) and a!=b: bag_false+=1
 if a==b and a!=b: role_false+=1
 if a==b: role_hit+=1
# TE common driver
T=80000; X=[]; Yn=[]; Yt=[]; Z=[]
prevz=random.randint(0,1)
for _ in range(T):
 z=random.randint(0,1); x=z^(1 if random.random()<0.12 else 0); yn=z^(1 if random.random()<0.12 else 0); yt=prevz^(1 if random.random()<0.12 else 0)
 X.append(x); Yn.append(yn); Yt.append(yt); Z.append(z); prevz=z
te=cmi(X,Yn,Yt); tec=cmi(X,Yn,[(Yt[i],Z[i]) for i in range(T)])
# partition-search null
K=16; nt=2500; nv=30000
trX=[random.randrange(K) for _ in range(nt)]; trY=[random.randrange(K) for _ in range(nt)]; vaX=[random.randrange(K) for _ in range(nv)]; vaY=[random.randrange(K) for _ in range(nv)]
best=(-1,None,None)
for _ in range(800):
 g=random.randint(2,6); part=[random.randrange(g) for _ in range(K)]
 for j in range(g): part[j]=j
 random.shuffle(part)
 tr=mi([part[x] for x in trX],[part[y] for y in trY])
 if tr>best[0]: best=(tr,g,part[:])
btr,bg,bp=best; bva=mi([bp[x] for x in vaX],[bp[y] for y in vaY])
# stage factorial
def mean_case(g,w,r,synergy,n=30000):
 s=0.0
 for _ in range(n): s+=0.25*g+0.18*r+synergy*g*w*r+random.gauss(0,0.4)
 return s/n
def omega(sy):
 m={(g,w,r):mean_case(g,w,r,sy) for g in (0,1) for w in (0,1) for r in (0,1)}
 return m[(1,1,1)]-m[(1,1,0)]-m[(1,0,1)]-m[(0,1,1)]+m[(1,0,0)]+m[(0,1,0)]+m[(0,0,1)]-m[(0,0,0)]
